With expert utilisation of Unreal Engine 5 working alongside some impressive custom tech, Namco Bandai has refined the Ace Combat formula to its zenith, with Ace Combat 8 delivering a genuine game of the year contender. John explains why he rates this game so highly and takes us on a tour of series history.

Our PC performance review for The Witcher 3 Remastered raised some eyebrows when it came to CPU behaviour with path tracing enabled in one of the game's most challenging areas. Most of the analysis was based on version 5.00c, with re-tests carried out on areas highlighed by the 5.01 patch notes - but it seems that 5.01 has also improved CPU performance too, as Rich demonstrates.

Many thanks to Rayan for all of our The Witcher 3 Remastered PC coverage.
